## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run build` succeeds with no new warnings

- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` updated
- [ ] No new third-party runtime requests
- [ ] Any new colour checked for contrast against `--paper-sunk` in both themes
- [ ] Still works with JavaScript disabled
